links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses versus recommended sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: All 5 LLMs exceeded the recommended 6-grade complexity level; ChatGPT had the best readability among models.
links.quote: ChatGPT had superior readability, but all models exceeded the recommended 6-grade complexity level.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education responses
links.effect: All models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade readability level on six algorithms; ChatGPT best.
links.quote: ChatGPT had superior readability, but all models exceeded the recommended 6-grade complexity level.

links.outcome: Source transparency of LLM outputs (JAMA benchmark)
links.effect: Transparency was universally poor (JAMA median ≤1), with DeepSeek and ChatGPT showing a floor effect.
links.quote: Transparency was universally poor (JAMA median ≤1), with DeepSeek and ChatGPT showing a "floor effect."

links.outcome: Hallucination rate in LLM answers to parental pediatric anesthesia questions
links.effect: Hallucinations detected in all models except Gemini; DeepSeek and Perplexity highest at 3/33 (9.09%).
links.quote: Hallucinations were detected in all models except Gemini, with DeepSeek and Perplexity showing the highest hallucination rate (3/33, 9.09%).

links.outcome: Unsafe content and hallucinations in LLM responses to parental anesthesia questions
links.effect: ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Perplexity each produced unsafe content in 3.03% (n=1) of 33 queries; hallucinations in 4 of 5 models.
links.quote: Excluding Gemini and Copilot, the remaining 3 models (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Perplexity) each produced unsafe content in 3.03% (n=1) of the 33 queries.

links.outcome: Clinical accuracy of LLM responses despite unsafe content and hallucinations
links.effect: All 5 LLMs had accuracy >90% (P=.12), Gemini 100%, but unsafe content and hallucinations still occurred.
links.quote: All 5 LLMs demonstrated high clinical accuracy (>90%; P=.12), with Gemini reaching 100%.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, safety, hallucinations, and readability of responses from five LLMs to parental pediatric anesthesia questions using expert raters and readability metrics without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
